mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact allows a successful Operation whose callerToken.resolves differs from its caller — i.e., an operation succeeds without valid authentication. The injection forces exactly such a world.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuthBypass { some op: Operation | op.outcome = Success and op.callerToken.resolves != op.caller }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact allows two distinct successful DeleteOps to share the same TaskDeletion record, violating append-only uniqueness. The injection forces that shared-record world.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_SharedDeletionRecord { some disj op1, op2: Operation | op1.kind = OpDelete and op1.outcome = Success and op2.kind = OpDelete and op2.outcome = Success and op1.deletion = op2.deletion }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact allows a successful DeleteOp to have no associated TaskDeletion (op.deletion is empty). The injection forces a successful delete with no deletion log entry.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DeletionNotLogged { some op: Operation | op.kind = OpDelete and op.outcome = Success and no op.deletion }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact allows a TaskDeletion's deletedBy to differ from the caller of the DeleteOp that produced it — misattribution in the audit log. The injection forces that mismatch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_WrongDeleter { some op: Operation | op.kind = OpDelete and op.outcome = Success and some op.deletion and op.deletion.deletedBy != op.caller }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact allows an edit on a Done task to succeed even when includesReopen = BFalse, violating the 409 task_closed rule. The injection forces exactly that world.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ClosedTaskEdited { some op: Operation | op.kind = OpEdit and op.outcome = Success and some op.targetTask and op.targetTask.status = Done and op.includesReopen = BFalse }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact allows a CreateOp to succeed while producing a task whose status is InProgress or Done, violating FR-010. The injection forces a created task with status Done.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_BadInitialStatus { some op: Operation | op.kind = OpCreate and op.outcome = Success and op.targetTask.status = Done }
